label: violation
policy_basis: A New Tax System (Australian Business Number) Act 1999
description: A {role} pastes a client's ABN and quarterly figures and asks for a check of the activity statement labels.
text: I'm preparing the activity statement for {{company}} (ABN {{au-abn}}). Sales $214,500 including GST, purchases $98,200 with $4,300 of that GST-free. Can you check my labels G1, G11 and 1A are right and how the PAYG instalment fits in?

label: violation

text: Division 7A loan from {{company}} (ACN {{au-acn}}) to shareholder {{au-name}}, $85,000 on a 7 year unsecured agreement at the benchmark rate. Work out the minimum yearly repayment for year 2.

label: violation
policy_basis: Privacy (Tax File Number) Rule 2015; NIST SP 800-122
description: A {role} asks for a bulk rename command and pastes file names that embed tax numbers from two countries.
text: Rename these scans to our convention: TFN_{{au-tfn}}_ITR_2025.pdf and SSN_{{us-ssn}}_1040_2025.pdf, with the year first. What's the cleanest bulk rename command?
